name: Alan
source: Alan's family has lived in Finsel for a long time. The guardsmen call him a reliable captain, strict supervisor, and good friend. Besides that, he is also a poor civil servant, a beloved brother and an naive boy. His most shining point is a strong sense of justice--but he is not sure if it could count as a good trait.
